sloka: तत् इदम् न विभाति अद्य विहीनम् तेन धीमता ।व्योमेव श्शिना हीनमप्भुष्क इव सागरः ॥२-७२-२०॥
transliteration: tat idam na vibhāti adya vihīnam tena dhīmatā ।vyomeva śśinā hīnamapbhuṣka iva sāgaraḥ ॥2-72-20॥

translations.english: But today this couch without my sagacious father no longer shines like the sky without the Moon or like the sea evaporated.
